description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for data population between source and target objects in a sales management system. It manages locale settings and defines an abstract method for creating target instances.

classes.name: AbstractDataPopulator
classes.description: An abstract generic class that defines a template for populating data from a source to a target object, with locale management and an abstract method for target creation.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for data population.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the current locale used in data population.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Performs the population of data from source to target, delegating target creation to an abstract method.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Abstract method for creating a new instance of the target object.
